content_sections.heading: SKAU Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the SKAU Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download SKAU Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for SKAU Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for SKAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Consultant/Technical Advisor posts at Shri Krishna AYUSH University Kurukshetra is scheduled for 24 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the Technical Advisor post?
faq.answer: For the Technical Advisor position, candidates must possess a B.E./B.Tech. or equivalent degree in a relevant field from a recognized institution and have a minimum of 10 years of total experience in an engineering capacity, with at least 5 years in the relevant field.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Junior Consultant (Matron) post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Junior Consultant (Matron) post is Rs. 35,000/- per month or Rs. 30,000/- per month, depending on the specific requirements and the University's decision.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available in this SKAU recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Consultant/Technical Advisor positions at Shri Krishna AYUSH University Kurukshetra.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q6. What is the experience required for the Junior Consultant (Matron) post?
faq.answer: For the Junior Consultant (Matron) role, candidates need to have a Post-Graduate Diploma in Management/MBA/M.E./M.Tech. and 03-05 years of relevant experience, preferably from a State or Central Government background.

faq.question: Q7. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at Shri Krishna AYUSH University Kurukshetra, Haryana, Pin code 136118.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any age limit for the Technical Advisor post?
faq.answer: While specific age limits are not detailed, candidates applying for the Technical Advisor post must have a minimum of 10 years of experience in an engineering capacity.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original certificates and testimonials, along with one set of self-attested photocopies of educational documents and experience certificates.

faq.question: Q10. What is the nature of the engagement for these posts?
faq.answer: The engagement for these positions is purely on a temporary basis, initially for a period of six months or as desired by the University authority, whichever is less.
